report.requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
report.evidence: Welcome to Snap Inc.’s Privacy Policy.
report.reason: The policy identifies the controller as Snap Inc.

report.requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
report.condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
report.evidence: Have any questions about the information here or wish to contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO)?
report.reason: The policy provides a way to contact the DPO.

report.requirement: The personal data that is collected
report.evidence: This section provides you with details on what information we collect.
report.reason: The policy clearly states the personal data collected.

report.requirement: The means used to collect personal data
report.evidence: we collect information you provide to us, generate information when you use our Services, and in some cases receive data from others.
report.reason: The policy specifies the means used to collect personal data.

report.requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
report.evidence: we use the information we collect to provide you with personalized products and Services that we work hard to build and improve.
report.reason: The policy clearly states the purpose of collecting and processing personal data.

report.requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
report.evidence: Some jurisdictions require that we state our legal basis for processing data for particular purposes.
report.reason: The policy mentions legal basis but does not specify what those bases are.

report.requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
report.reason: The policy does not specify which personal data is mandatory or optional.

report.requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
report.reason: The policy does not mention the consequences of not providing personal data.

report.requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
report.evidence: We may share some of your information with your friends on Snapchat or other Snapchatters.
report.reason: The policy clearly states the parties with whom personal data is shared.

report.requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
report.evidence: we may collect your personal information from, transfer it to, and store and process it in the United States or other countries outside of where you live.
report.reason: The policy explicitly mentions the transfer of personal data outside the Kingdom.

report.requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
report.evidence: As a general rule, we keep information as long as you tell us to
report.reason: The policy clearly states how long personal data is kept.

report.requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
report.reason: The policy does not mention how personal data is stored and destroyed.

report.requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
report.evidence: you can access, update, and delete your information
report.reason: The policy mentions some rights but does not cover all specified rights.

report.requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
report.evidence: you can access and edit most of your basic information
report.reason: The policy provides some information on exercising rights but lacks full details.
The policy does not mention how to withdraw consent.

report.requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.evidence: we use your information to enhance the safety and security of our Services
report.reason: The policy mentions measures for safety and security but lacks specific details on protecting personal data.

report.requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.reason: The policy does not address whether decisions are made solely by automated processing.
